name: 01_scattering_scan
caption: 两模型参考与三个条件网络的 R(E)、T(E)；底部刻线为训练能量，扫描点多数为未训练能量。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 02_scattering_phases
caption: 固定入射相位后的透射与反射相位；各连续有效段展开，|r|<10⁻⁵ 的反射相位屏蔽，段间不解释相位跳跃。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 03_dirac_complex_components
caption: 四个指定能量的复波函数逐分量，三种子全部显示；重合曲线表示误差低于此尺度的可见度，误差另图显示。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 03_kg_complex_components
caption: 四个指定能量的复波函数逐分量，三种子全部显示；重合曲线表示误差低于此尺度的可见度，误差另图显示。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 04_pointwise_errors
caption: 固定入射相位后的逐点波形误差，Dirac 为复旋量模、KG 为复 φ 的模；全部三种子，不进行事后缩放。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 05_seed_error_distribution
caption: 全部固定能量与三种子的误差分布；每组 n=12（四能量×三种子），短黑线为算术均值；失败 MLP 不剔除。组间不是等参数单因素对照。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 06_local_current
caption: 单位入射通量下 j(x) 和参考透射流；坐标科学计数偏移使微小流变化可见。守恒为辅助证据，训练没有流损失。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 07_conditional_heldout_errors
caption: 未训练能量上三种子条件网络的波形、T 绝对误差与流守恒偏差；水平线为统一验收阈值。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 08_training_curves
caption: 全部固定能量/种子的训练记录。RBF 为直接解及细化阶段，MLP 为 Adam/L-BFGS 目标调用；损失尺度不同，不比较曲线绝对值。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 09_scan_total_cost
caption: 同一扫描的传统积分、逐能量重训、条件网络训练加全部推理成本；条件网络为三个种子成本的均值。机器已有 R12 后台训练，时间为实际负载下的墙钟值；准确度不同，不是隔离资源的速度排名。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.

name: 10_reference_convergence
caption: 参考区间、容差和测试网格加密证据；值为四个固定能量的最大差异。零差仅为同算法同设置的恒等复算，不证明准确性。
statistics: All seeds; mean/sample SD where shown; no significance tests.
image_integrity: No data editing; logarithmic display uses a 1e-16 floor only.
